regions.name: Green Hollow
regions.description: A quiet valley of moss, old stones, and low fog where the first roads of the realm begin.

locations.name: Mossway Herbalist
locations.description: A patient healer whose shop is hidden among the roots and herbs.

locations.name: Sunlit Bane
locations.description: A spring-fed shrine that restores health and mana to the weary.

locations.name: Moss Market
locations.description: A small roadside market selling simple supplies and tools.

regions.name: Ambercross
regions.description: A wind-bent settlement of traders and caravan keepers, perched along the lower pass.

locations.name: Stone Wayfinder
locations.description: A guide who reads old cairns and whispered winds.

locations.name: Amber Shrine
locations.description: A warm stone basin of spring water that steadies the body.

regions.name: Frostpeak
regions.description: A bitter mountain hold where the air bites clean and the paths grow narrow and dangerous.

locations.name: Rime Guide
locations.description: A mountain scout who knows every ridge and loose shelf of ice.

locations.name: Frostwell
locations.description: A natural vent of steam-warm water hidden in the stone.
